name: Compatibility mode — non-RT lighting (PPSA21564)
description: Experimental boot compatibility for Astro Bot PPSA21564, game v01.007.000. Selects the existing non-tiled deferred renderer and skips unsupported GI/RT probes. Both original instruction signatures were verified against the supplied eboot.bin. Enable before launch; no original game files are changed. Some lighting will be absent and stability is not guaranteed.
